text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, D-dimer). There is mild renal impairment (creatinine high), mild transaminitis (ALT), and coagulopathy (INR elevated). The findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible infection or sepsis, and risk for bleeding or thrombotic complications. Immediate clinical evaluation is recommended.
